# Bekon Agent
> Android app that lets an AI agent the owner trusts see and operate the phone over MCP, with consent. Source for auditing.

Audit guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tsol/bekon-agent/v1.0.13/AUDIT.md
Zip: https://github.com/tsol/bekon-agent/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.13.zip
